assessment.reading: Interpret sophisticated scientific, technical and research texts with precision, methodological awareness and appropriate skepticism.
assessment.listening: Extract methods, findings, assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and implications from expert scientific communication.
assessment.speaking: Explain, question and defend evidence-based positions using accurate C2+ scientific and academic register.
assessment.writing: Produce research syntheses, methodological critiques, technical briefs and evidence-based recommendations with strong cohesion.
assessment.decisionMaking: Evaluate evidence quality, uncertainty, technical constraints, risks and competing research priorities before recommending action.
assessment.presentation: Translate complex scientific findings into clear, accurate and audience-appropriate presentations without oversimplification.

successCriteria: distinguishes observation, evidence, hypothesis, inference, interpretation and conclusion
uses advanced scientific and research vocabulary accurately and flexibly
recognises methodological limitations, uncertainty and possible confounding factors
interprets quantitative and qualitative evidence without overclaiming
constructs and critiques research arguments using evidence and appropriate qualification
shifts naturally between specialist, academic, professional and public science registers
communicates technical risk and uncertainty responsibly
translates research findings into practical and strategically framed recommendations
responds effectively to high-pressure scientific and technology scenarios
integrates research, listening, analysis, speaking and writing at C2+ level
